how_to_use: 1) Read the guide. 2) Fill the rate card with real rates. 3) Draft each SOW with numbered deliverables and exclusions. 4) Map milestones to deliverables. 5) Log requests daily in the scope register, count revisions, and issue change orders before doing changed work.
limitations: Templates are general starting points, not jurisdiction-specific legal documents. The kit cannot compel client behavior, collect payment, or resolve disputes. Effectiveness depends on consistent written use. No income or client-retention outcome is promised.
long_description: A contract and workflow kit that helps solo freelancers define what is included, what is excluded, and what happens when requests change. Includes a statement of work template with an exclusions clause, a milestone map worksheet, a change-order form, a revision counter log, a rate card template, and client pushback scripts, plus a 5-sheet workbook and a step-by-step guide covering the 15-minute courtesy rule and say-yes-and-quote method.
name: Freelancer Scope Control Kit ($39)
outcome_statement: A freelancer who uses the kit consistently will have written deliverables, exclusions, revision counts, and change records for each engagement, which supports calmer scope conversations and clearer billing for out-of-scope work.
problem_statement: Vague contracts, unfunded milestones, and unlimited revisions let scope expand without pay. Solo earners absorb the extra hours because nothing in writing defines the boundary or the price of change.
short_description: SOW with exclusions, milestone map, change-order form, revision counter, rate card, and pushback scripts for fixed-price and hourly freelancers.
support: Email support for file access and usage questions. Response within 3 business days (illustrative service target). Legal review of completed contracts is not included.
whats_included: Guide (PDF-ready markdown): scope method, 15-minute courtesy rule, say-yes-and-quote scripts, checklists, illustrative examples
Workbook (XLSX): scope register, milestone map, change-order log with billed-amount formulas, revision counter, rate card
4 DOCX templates: SOW with exclusions clause, change-order form, pushback message scripts, revision-limit clause insert
who_for: Freelance writers, developers, and designers on fixed-price or hourly contracts
Solo earners who scope, deliver, and invoice their own work
Freelancers who want written revision and change boundaries
who_not_for: Anyone expecting automated enforcement or automatic client acceptance
